[[Korr's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Korr, Living Flame]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Turai's Procession]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Fire Magic]])
:[[Fire Magic]] +1 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +45 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Flame Artifact (flame)]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*[[Flame Artifact]] from collector [[Jovial Pete]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*[[Flame Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Devotion]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
AND
*White [[dye]]
